allow: Bash(node -e "const db = require\('@tombatossals/chords-db'\); console.log\('keys:', Object.keys\(db\)\); console.log\('guitar keys:', Object.keys\(db.guitar\)\); console.log\('chord keys sample:', Object.keys\(db.guitar.chords\).slice\(0,5\)\); const C = db.guitar.chords['C']; console.log\('C chord types:', C.map\(c=>c.suffix\).slice\(0,10\)\); console.log\('C major sample:', JSON.stringify\(C.find\(c=>c.suffix==='major'\).positions[0], null, 2\)\);")
